title: Could your family find the important information in an emergency?

scenes.text:
Could your family find
important information
in an emergency?

Keep key contacts,
medications, and allergies
organized.

Add school and child-care
contacts plus two family
meeting places.

Store it securely.
Never post private family
information publicly.

Review every 6 months.
Prepared today.
Stronger tomorrow.
